name: Swarm of Insects (Spiders)
printing: First-print text with official 2018 Monster Manual errata
pageNumbering: Printed folio 338 is page 339, counting the cover.
section: Appendix A: Miscellaneous Creatures, Variant: Insect Swarms
errataApplied: Grappled condition immunity from the Swarm of X erratum.
sourceDistinctions: Swarm of Spiders is the printed sidebar label. Swarm of Insects (Spiders) is the other catalog label for this variant.
Keep 20-ft. walking and climbing speeds and 10-ft. blindsight from the base. Add Spider Climb, Web Sense, and Web Walker.
Bites retains the base profile’s piercing damage at both HP bands. This variant receives no poison rider.
appearanceEvidence: The entry identifies the animals in the swarm. Colors and arrangement come from the reused illustration.
habitatEvidence: The book gives no habitat list for this variant. The searchable locations are editorial encounter tags.
